notices.title: R platform builds require follow-up
notices.message: Some R binary builds remain failed or under validation on macOS runner preparation and ARM64/WebR packaging. The expected source versions are available from R-universe, as the registry matrix records. These version badges do not establish that all R platform matrices passed. The macOS DAG retry failed before package download because rustup-init was absent; packaging fixes and platform checks remain in progress.

links.label: Official macOS preparation action used by the failed jobs
